name: Wardrobe
description: Save your worn outfits and switch between them instantly by hotkey or menu, with a live 3D preview.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Switch outfits in the world — the game confirms the change with its own banner.
The Wardrobe window — saved outfits with a live 3D preview of the hovered one.

added: Save the outfit you're wearing into a named slot, then switch back to it instantly by hotkey (first 8 slots) or from the Wardrobe window.
Live 3D preview — hover a saved outfit to see it on your character; drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, shift-drag to pan.
Rename, reorder, apply, update (re-capture your current outfit into a slot) and delete outfits. Update and delete ask to confirm.
Outfits are saved per character, and available in English, 日本語, ไทย, Bahasa Indonesia and Filipino.
